summary.zh: 稳定度代表玩家阵营内部是否稳固。它主要由组织成员对玩家阵营的信任度平均值形成，是判断组织会不会动摇的重要指标。
summary.en: Stability represents how solid the player faction is internally. It is mainly based on the average trust of organization members and helps indicate whether the faction may fracture.

items.zh: 顶部 HUD 的稳定度显示玩家阵营成员信任度的平均情况。
items.en: The top HUD stability value reflects the average trust of player faction members.

items.zh: 成员越信任玩家阵营，组织越不容易出现内部动摇。
items.en: The more members trust the faction, the less likely the organization is to shake internally.

items.zh: 稳定度是组织长期扩张时需要关注的基础指标。
items.en: Stability is a basic metric to watch during long-term expansion.

items.zh: 成员被迫离开、压力崩溃或错误决策都可能影响稳定度。
items.en: Member departures, stress breakdowns, and poor decisions can damage stability.

items.zh: 如果组织扩张过快但信任基础不足，稳定度会更脆弱。
items.en: If the organization expands too quickly without a trust base, stability becomes fragile.

items.zh: 稳定度低时，组织更难承受管理层压力和高风险行动。
items.en: Low stability makes it harder to endure faculty pressure and risky actions.

items.zh: 优先维护核心成员和行动小队成员的信任。
items.en: Prioritize trust among core members and action squad members.

items.zh: 不要只追求人数增长，忽视成员关系。
items.en: Do not pursue member count while ignoring member relationships.
